remarks: HIGHEST & BEST by Wednesday (8/20) at 5PM! Both feature updated, spacious kitchens with abundant cabinet space, gas range, microwave, refrigerator, and dishwasher. The first-floor unit includes two large bedrooms, full bath, generous living room, and a fully finished lower level with two sizable rooms. The second-floor unit offers two large bedrooms, full bath, expansive living room, private entrance, and deck. Enjoy ample paved parking, a bluestone patio, and yard, all just minutes from downtown Stamford, Metro-North, shops, dining, and waterfront parks. Don't miss this rare turnkey property with outstanding rental income potential!
